description: Repo-scale (cpp-eventbus): add an atomic all-or-nothing batch-publish method
prompts: Add `int EventBus::publishBatch(const std::vector<std::pair<std::string, std::string>>& items)` (topic, payload pairs). It must validate the WHOLE batch before publishing anything: return -1 (and log/deliver NOTHING) if `items` is empty, or if ANY topic in the batch is empty - even one bad topic anywhere in the batch must leave the EventLog and all subscribers completely untouched, not just the items after the bad one. Only once every topic is confirmed non-empty should the whole batch actually be published (reusing the existing `publish` method for each item in order). Returns the total number of subscriber callbacks invoked across the batch.
name: add_cpp_eventbus_publish_batch_atomic
